opening.argument: The material expressly presents Forsage as a business and network-marketing opportunity, with the description inviting viewers to join a "fastest growing business" identified as "NETWOK MARKETING." The frame pairs "TODAY MY INCOME" and the calculation "15×89=1335/.INR" with the repeated call to action "Join forsage." That combination connects participation in this recruitment-oriented opportunity to a claimed personal income calculation, rather than showing neutral commentary or an ordinary product sale. The evidence therefore supports treating the presentation as a recruitment-commission and tiered-matrix solicitation.
